characters.name: KASS KIIRA
characters.description: Väike valge kass roosade kõrvade ja sabaga, kandmas väikest sinist salli kaelas, suured rohelised silmad, armas ja uudishimulik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: KOER KUKI
characters.description: Väike pruun koer floppy kõrvade ja lühikese sabaga, kandmas väikest rohelist mütsi peas, suured sõbralikud pruunid silmad, rõõmus ja mänguhimuline näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Kuki elutuba
locations.description: Kuki's cozy living room with light yellow walls, a soft blue rug on a wooden floor, a single small rectangular window on the back wall showing a green tree outside. A small red armchair is in the corner. Cartoon style.

locations.name: Mänguplats õues
locations.description: A sunny grassy area with a large, clear puddle in the middle. Green trees and bushes are visible in the background. Bright blue sky with a few fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Kass Kiira sits on the soft blue rug in Kuki's living room, playing with a small red yarn ball. Koer Kuki lies comfortably on the rug next to her, wagging his tail happily. The room has light yellow walls and a wooden floor. Warm sunlight streams from the window. Cartoon style.

Kass Kiira and Koer Kuki stand by the window in Kuki's living room, looking outside with curious and excited expressions. Through the window, a large, clear puddle is visible on the green grass outside. The room has light yellow walls and a wooden floor. Cartoon style.

Kass Kiira and Koer Kuki are searching near a small wooden shelf in Kuki's living room. Kiira peeks under a small red armchair with a determined look. Kuki sniffs around a small pile of objects on the floor, his tail wagging. The room has light yellow walls and a wooden floor. Cartoon style.

Kass Kiira and Koer Kuki stand proudly in Kuki's living room, next to two pairs of colorful rain boots. Kuki points his paw at a pair of green boots. Kiira smiles happily at a pair of blue boots. The room has light yellow walls and a wooden floor. Cartoon style.

Kass Kiira, wearing bright blue rain boots, and Koer Kuki, wearing cheerful green rain boots, walk happily together towards the large, clear puddle in the sunny grassy area. Green trees and bushes are in the background. Cartoon style.

Kass Kiira and Koer Kuki stand excitedly at the very edge of the big, clear puddle in the sunny grassy area. Their blue and green rain boots are ready. They look at the puddle with wide, happy smiles, eager to jump. Cartoon style.

Kass Kiira and Koer Kuki are joyfully jumping and splashing together in the middle of the large, clear puddle. Water splashes playfully around their blue and green rain boots. They both have wide, happy smiles and are laughing. Cartoon style.

Kass Kiira and Koer Kuki are still energetically splashing and jumping in the big puddle, their faces full of laughter and pure joy. More water splashes around them, creating a playful scene. Green trees and a bright blue sky are in the background. Cartoon style.
